```{r}
# Get input and output
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$xenografts_run_sipsic$input
output = pipeline$xenografts_run_sipsic$output
```

# Functions

```{r}
library(qs2)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringi)
library(reticulate)
library(ggplotify)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GSEABase))
library(SiPSiC)
library(SourceFromGithub)
source_from_github(repositoy = "DEG_functions",version = "0.2.59")
source_from_github(repositoy = "sc_general_functions",version = "0.1.34",script_name = "functions.R")


```

# Data


```{r}
xeno <- qs_read(input$xeno)
hallmark_genesets = getGmt(paste0(input$genesets))
hif_targets = scan(input$hif_targets, character(), quote = "")
# add hif targets to genesets
hif_targets <- list(hif_targets = GeneSet(geneIds = hif_targets, setName = "hif_targets"))
genesets <- c(hallmark_genesets, hif_targets)
names(genesets) = c(names(hallmark_genesets), names(hif_targets))
```


# DE pathways

```{r}
calculatePathwayScores <- function(pathwayToScore, countsMatrix) {
  pathwayName <- pathwayToScore@setName
  message(pathwayName)
  pathwayGenes <- pathwayToScore@geneIds
  pathwayScoresObject <- getPathwayScores(countsMatrix, pathwayGenes)
  suppressWarnings(
    if (is.null(pathwayScoresObject)) {
      return(NA)
    }
  )
  return(pathwayScoresObject$pathwayScores)
}
```



```{r}
pathwayScoreLists <- lapply(X = genesets@.Data, calculatePathwayScores, xeno@assays$RNA@data %>% expm1())
names(pathwayScoreLists) = names(genesets)
pathwayScoreLists <- pathwayScoreLists[!is.na(pathwayScoreLists)] #remove NA pathways
pathwayScoresMatrix <- as.data.frame(do.call("rbind", pathwayScoreLists))
```

```{r}
# save
saveRDS(object = pathwayScoresMatrix,file = paste0(params$data_out_dir,basename(output$sipsic_matrix)))
```
